smtp.notes: Only non-secret connection settings live here. SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USERNAME, and SMTP_PASSWORD environment variables are required for OTP emails to actually send — see docs/INSTALL.md. This 'host'/'port' are just fallback defaults if the SMTP_HOST/SMTP_PORT env vars aren't set.

notes: Edit 'database.password' to match your local MySQL root password before running the server. See docs/INSTALL.md.
